judgment.rationale: The issue's reported Ctrl/Alt shortcut loss, recovery after lock/unlock, and WeChat-triggered recurrence overlap the open tracker #38128. The same WeChat/TIM compatibility report #37967 was closed explicitly in favor of #38128.
evidence: Issue #22799 commenters report Ctrl+Tab/Alt+Tab remaps stopping, with lock/unlock restoring them.
A 2024 comment says opening WeChat makes the shortcut failure recur consistently.
The open issue #38128 describes keyboard shortcuts failing after launching WeChat or TIM; #37967 was closed by a maintainer as a duplicate of #38128 for this same app-specific behavior.
judgment.recommended_action: Consolidate any further WeChat/TIM compatibility investigation under #38128 rather than beginning a separate fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: The report's distinctive WeChat/TIM trigger is already represented by open issue #38128; no separate PowerToys change should be proposed here.

issue_context.summary: The older Ctrl/Alt swap report includes the same WeChat-triggered loss of Keyboard Manager shortcuts now tracked by #38128.
known_information: The original report uses PowerToys 0.65.0 and describes physical Alt/Ctrl swapping plus Ctrl+Tab/Alt+Tab remaps.
Comments say a lock/unlock can restore behavior and that opening desktop WeChat reproducibly brings the failure back.
The separate WeChat/TIM compatibility issue #37967 is closed with a maintainer explanation that it duplicates #38128.
inferences: The WeChat-specific instance likely shares the app-compatibility concern tracked by #38128; the reports do not prove every intermittent Ctrl/Alt failure has the same cause.
issue_context.analysis: The issue should not be treated as a fresh design candidate because an open, more specific report owns the same external-app trigger. Preserve the related work and avoid claiming that the underlying defect is fixed.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body and all 14 comments, including the WeChat reproduction and lock/unlock reports.
Checked #37967: a maintainer closed it as a duplicate of #38128, explicitly citing WeChat/TIM making Keyboard Manager shortcuts invalid.
The selected issue has no current assignee or linked fix.

comment.body: This report's WeChat-triggered loss of Keyboard Manager shortcuts appears to match the app-specific compatibility issue tracked in #38128. The #38128 thread also covers WeChat/TIM launch causing global shortcuts to stop working, while this thread adds the Ctrl/Alt swap and lock/unlock observations. Please add those distinguishing details to #38128 and close this report as a duplicate if maintainers confirm the same failure path.
